status: fitted models are in bundle/models.joblib (trained on data to 2026-10-21, morning Huber to 2026-08-31 (no futures after 08-28); daily bars after 2026-09-04 built from MT5 1m; see bundle/manifest.json); predict.py scores a request; the weekly fit (02_PROTOCOL section 1) should rerun build_data.py then fit.py on data up to the last trading day before the prediction week.
graded_live_days: 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-13, 2 stocks x 2 rounds every day = 20 predictions, each saved with a timestamp before its cutoff

uses_volume.answer: yes, both v9 models use volume
uses_volume.older_bundles: v5 and v5.3 (the JSON files next to this one) use no volume; volatility_20d and realized_volatility_per_bar are price volatility
uses_volume.units_warning: every volume feature is a ratio to the 20-day mean of the same series, so units cancel, but the 20 history days and today must come from the SAME source and unit (shares, not lots). Do not mix MT5/SET official volume for history with Oanor volume_delta for today.

morning.target: P_d = close of the last morning 1m bar with bar_end <= 12:30 on day d
morning.anchor: anchor_m = C_{d-1} - D_d (yesterday official close minus today's XD dividend, 0 if none)

fallback.use_when: fut_post or a peer close is missing, so the Huber row is incomplete

afternoon.target: C_d = official close of day d

picked_model.kind: HistGradientBoostingRegressor(learning_rate=0.05, min_samples_leaf=50, l2_regularization=1.0, max_depth=<yearly pick>, max_iter=<mean best iteration>, early_stopping=False), sklearn
picked_model.pooled_note: one model for both stocks, extra column is_kbank (1 KBANK, 0 ADVANC)
picked_model.confirm_skill: +4.12% vs baseline (2023-01 to 2026-09-04), shrinking each year

training_rules.window: expanding from 2017-04-01, refit weekly on rows dated before the week's first day (last fit before the graded week: after the close of Fri 2026-11-06)
training_rules.clip: each feature clipped at the training window's 1% / 99% quantiles; the same bounds are applied to the live row
training_rules.standardise: Huber only: z-score with the training window's clipped mean / SD
training_rules.missing: training rows with any missing feature are dropped

spx.formula: log(last ^GSPC close dated <= d-1 / last close dated <= prev_day-1)

thd.formula: same as spx on THD (iShares Thailand ETF)

thb.formula: same as spx on THB=X; use each bar's own London date

n225.formula: log(Nikkei open on d / last close dated <= prev_day); 0 if Tokyo shut on d

hsi.formula: log(Hang Seng open on d / last close dated <= prev_day); 0 if HK shut on d

fut_post.formula: log(fut_1655 / fut_1645) on prev_day: fut_1645 = close of the S50 front-month 30m bar starting 16:15, fut_1655 = close of the bar starting 16:45 (TFEX closes 16:55)

vol_prev.formula: log(V_{d-1} / mean(V over the 20 days ending d-1)), needs >= 15 of 20

peer_prev.formula: mean over BBL, KTB, SCB, TTB, KKP, TISCO of log(ATC close_{d-1} / ATC close_{d-2})
peer_prev.source: 1m bars of the 6 banks, session closing_label

gap_days.formula: calendar days from prev SET day to d

xd.formula: D_d / C_{d-1} (dividend going XD today, 0 if none)

atc_push.formula: log(C_{d-1} / last afternoon continuous 1m close on d-1)

jump.formula: log(first morning 1m open on d / anchor_m)

vwap_gap.formula: log(P_d / morning VWAP), VWAP = sum(close*volume)/sum(volume) over morning 1m bars

range_am.formula: log(max morning high / min morning low)

vol_am.formula: log(morning volume on d / mean morning volume of the 20 days before d), needs >= 15

post_2024.formula: 1 if d >= 2024-03-25 (afternoon opens 14:00) else 0; always 1 live

tick_dir.formula: sign of the last price change among morning 1m closes (repeated prices removed), 0 if none

KBANK_ADVANC_1m_ohlcv.notes: true 1m OHLCV incl. volume; morning bars 09:56-12:30 bar_end; bars labelled by END time (MT5 labels by start, +1 min)

KBANK_ADVANC_official_daily_ohlcv.notes: official close C, open, high, low and VOLUME; last 21 days at least

bank_peers_1m_or_atc_close.notes: only the ATC (closing auction) price of the last 2 days is needed

s50_futures_30m.notes: the 16:45 bar of the previous day; without it the morning uses the fallback

yahoo_daily.notes: N225 and HSI opens of today must be in before 09:30 BKK

xd_dividends.notes: any XD date and THB amount for today

set_calendar.notes: previous trading day and gap length

oanor_feed_gaps: only ADVANC and KBANK: no bank peers, no S50 futures, no Yahoo
polling snapshots, not exchange 1m OHLCV: jump, range_am, tick_dir, vwap_gap will differ from training
volume_delta comes from cumulative volume; history must use the same source for vol_am / vwap_gap ratios
no official close or ATC price flagged
